messages:
alice_docs: FYI PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7894 - migration guide for 'Dedicated -> Private' - added a sensitive example (internal staging endpoint) so asking for security + legal review before merge. Preview: https://deploy-preview-7894--docs.redwood.ai

erin_docs: noted. CI preview link is failing atm, pinging ci-bot. Can we get both @carol_security and @dan_legal?

ci-bot: Docs preview failed · build 7894
 - markdownlint: 1 error (table-row-missing)
 - assets: /images/staging-arch.png 404
See: https://ci.redwood.ai/7894

alice_docs: I pushed a commit removing the absolute image path; replaced with relative one. Also replaced the literal internal host in example with <internal-host> for now.

bob_eng: quick take — prefer we redact host entirely and show 'https://example.customer' instead of placeholders. Also, the example curl includes an X-Internal-Token header; remove or show 'X-API-KEY: <REDACTED>'.

carol_security: Thanks for flagging. We need full redaction of any internal ips, hostnames, or tokens. Please replace with fictional domain and redact headers. Also remove stack traces that contain kube hostnames. I can do a final pass after the edits. @alice_docs please add a short security note in the PR description about the redaction.

alice_docs: added PR description note and pushed commit. Replaced host with https://customer.example and header with X-API-KEY: <REDACTED>. Removed stack trace. Link to updated preview: https://deploy-preview-7894--docs.redwood.ai/ (should be re-built)

ci-bot: Re-run triggered by alice_docs — build 7895
 - markdownlint: passed
 - assets: all found
 - docs-preview: success
Preview: https://deploy-preview-7895--docs.redwood.ai/

dan_legal: Quick read — prefer 'ensure that no customer identifiable information or internal pricing numbers are included'. Also prefer 'do not include internal contract references' instead of 'legalese'. Small wording tweak in section 'Customer data' -> pushed suggestion.

erin_docs: saw dan_legal suggestion, applied wording change and pushed. Can we get final approvals? Waiting on carol_security sign-off and dan_legal.

carol_security: Reviewed the updated preview. Redactions good. Approve from security side :white_check_mark: (no blockers)

dan_legal: Verified wording. Approve from legal. Please ensure the PR includes a changelog note for auditability.

alice_docs: changelog entry added. Who will merge? I'd prefer not to be the merger (out of office later today).

bob_eng: I can merge and squash after final CI green — doing it in a 1pm PT release window. Will do a small smoke test post-merge.

deploy-bot: Note: merge/smoke test scheduled for 2024-11-07 13:00 PT per @bob_eng

erin_docs: thanks everyone. After bob merges, please add the PR number to the docs release notes. Closing on my side.

alice_docs: thanks all :pray:
